The controllers are resting on a black rectangular box, likely the original retail packaging.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the box in photo 0.
The image contains a watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

Video of the console booting up and the controllers working.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
